host: local workstation, 8 vCPU visible to otelcol, 64 GB; Node v26.8.2; Postgres pgvector pg17, MinIO, Temporal 1.29.7 (isolated compose project router-e2e-20261021)

builds.main: e15996da (branch HEAD before this benchmark's fixes)

productionPolicy: PAGE_ROUTER_MODE=shadow, DOCSLURP_PDF_ENGINE=shadow, workspace pipeline defaults ('{}'): router decision-model (openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions first), vision google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (good-fast-hosted, max 4 pages/doc), embeddings perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b, contextual preambles qwen/qwen3.5-flash-02-23

layout.runtime: onnxruntime 1.31.0 CPU, 4 threads, resident loopback service

spend.scope: every paid call in the isolated database: smoke, pilots, warmups, main and postfix runs

aiUsageLogCheck.result: [ai-usage] log lines equal persisted usage_events rows for every paid metric

telemetry: No local SigNoz. Worker/API OTLP exported to a local OpenTelemetry Collector file exporter; S3 operation counts come from those spans. Production SigNoz was not used.

corpus.rule: development splits only; deterministic sorted selection; no held-out or test items

throughput.basis: Sequential single-document submissions on one local worker (docConcurrency 4 available, 1 document in flight); runtime = client wall time upload->completed; cost = paid provider calls only (local CPU and storage not priced).

storage.note: Ops counted from worker/API OTLP spans tagged with docslurp.runId (instrumented S3 client). LanceDB's native S3 traffic is not instrumented and is excluded. Stored = objects under the run prefix at the end (overwrites counted once).
